text:
Time? Ah, time... It's a river, isn't it? Always flowing, ever-changing. I don't measure it in hours or days, those are just man-made cages. My clock is the sun, the moon, the rhythm of the earth. A sunrise is a new canvas, a sunset a masterpiece completed.

I live in the now, you see. Yesterday is a faded dream, tomorrow a whisper on the wind. Today, this moment, this breath, this is where the magic happens. 

Some might call it reckless, living without a schedule, without a plan. But for me, it's liberation. Time becomes a collaborator, not a tyrant. It stretches and contracts, speeds up and slows down, dancing to the tune of my creative spirit.

And sometimes, when the stars are out and the world is quiet, I swear I can feel the pulse of eternity, the heartbeat of something ancient and vast. That's when I know, truly know, that time is just an illusion, a fleeting glimpse of something beyond our comprehension.

So, don't ask me to tell you the time. Ask me about the colours of the sunrise, the stories whispered by the wind, the song
